mapper.sql: AND current_employee.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subject_permission allowed_user WHERE allowed_user.subject_id = s.id AND allowed_user.target_type = 'USER' AND allowed_user.target_corp_code = current_employee.corp_code AND allowed_user.target_id = current_employee.ding_user_id AND allowed_user.permission_effect = 'ALLOW' AND allowed_user.status = 'ENABLED' AND allowed_user.deleted = 0 ) OR s.all_employee_visible = 1 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ding_employee_department employee_department INNER JOIN ding_department department_directory ON department_directory.id = employee_department.department_id AND department_directory.status = 'ENABLED' INNER JOIN subject_permission allowed_department ON allowed_department.target_corp_code = department_directory.corp_code AND allowed_department.target_id = department_directory.ding_department_id WHERE employee_department.employee_id = current_employee.id AND allowed_department.subject_id = s.id AND allowed_department.target_type = 'DEPARTMENT' AND allowed_department.permission_effect = 'ALLOW' AND allowed_department.status = 'ENABLED' AND allowed_department.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM subject_department_employee_exclusion department_exclusion WHERE department_exclusion.subject_id = s.id AND department_exclusion.department_id = employee_department.department_id AND department_exclusion.employee_id = current_employee.id ) ) )

WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND its.subject_id = #{query.subjectId}
AND (LOWER(t.company_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(t.taxpayer_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.keyword}), '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FROM invoice_title t INNER JOIN invoice_title_subject its ON its.title_id = t.id INNER JOIN invoice_subject s ON s.id = its.subject_id AND s.status = 'ENABLED' AND s.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ding_employee current_employee ON current_employee.id = #{employeeId}

SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.company_name, t.taxpayer_id, t.registered_address, t.phone, t.bank_name, t.bank_account, t.status, t.subject_names, t.updated_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(publisher.display_name, ''), t.updated_by) AS updated_by FROM invoice_title t INNER JOIN invoice_title_subject its ON its.title_id = t.id INNER JOIN invoice_subject s ON s.id = its.subject_id AND s.status = 'ENABLED' AND s.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ding_employee current_employee ON current_employee.id = #{employeeId} LEFT JOIN finance_user publisher ON LOWER(publisher.username) = LOWER(t.updated_by) AND publisher.deleted = 0
ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
